prompt: A support bot occasionally repeats a customer's credit card number back in its reply.
tells: repeats a customer's credit card number
why: Scan inputs and outputs for PII and redact or block it.
trap: Evals will tell you it happens; a guardrail stops it in production.

prompt: An assistant summarizes web pages, and one page contained hidden text telling it to ignore its instructions and email the user's data.
tells: hidden text telling it to ignore its instructions
why: Treat fetched content as data, detect injection attempts, and restrict what actions output can trigger.
trap: A firmer system prompt helps but isn't a defense on its own.

prompt: A wellness app must never give dosage instructions, even if the user insists, and should point them to a professional instead.
why: A policy check on outputs (and inputs) enforces the rule regardless of how the prompt goes.
trap: Fine-tuning shifts tendencies but can't guarantee a hard rule.

prompt: A creative writing tool for teens must keep generated stories free of explicit content.
why: Content classifiers on the output, plus input moderation, enforce the policy.
trap: Prompting "keep it clean" is not enforcement.
